description: Create ONE carousel post containing 2-10 separately generated photos, in the requested order. Use when the user asks for an image/product/photo carousel, not separate posts or a text slide deck. Supply a distinct complete brief for every slide, preserving all requested subjects and shared constraints. Use confirmed catalogue productIds and referenceImageIndex when supplied by the user. Original photos without AI changes use create_carousel_from_images instead. Returns generating, never finished; all slides must succeed before the carousel becomes a draft. Counts as one post. Never publish automatically.
name: create_photo_carousel
title: Create photo carousel
